title: Here's my ranking of all 12 jurors in 12 Angry Men (1957)

commenti.body: I love *12 Angry Men*, but there's probably been a total of ten days in my life—the five days after I saw this movie decades ago, and the five days after I rewatched it two years ago—when your post has any meaning to me. Maybe I'll try to remember to read it the next time I watch the movie! Glad you enjoyed it.
